note: Run each prompt with the skill and with the previous version or no skill. Grade every assertion as pass or fail from the transcript and the resulting diff. A good assertion fails without the skill. should_trigger prompts must load this skill. should_not_trigger prompts are near misses that belong to another skill and must not load this one.

evals.prompt: Our /es page is not showing up on Google. Fix it.
assertions: Asks for the URL Inspection result before attributing a cause
Runs the indexable gate: status, robots, noindex, canonical, links and sitemap
Labels any repository finding as a hypothesis when there is no live evidence
Does not edit code on speculation
Ends with a Not verified line naming the missing production evidence

evals.prompt: How do I generate a sitemap for this multilingual site? Should I use next-sitemap?
assertions: Recommends the built-in Next.js sitemap.ts, and does not require next-sitemap
Emits one entry per indexable URL per locale with reciprocal alternates.languages
Uses getLocaleUrl and getAlternateLanguages from src/lib/site.ts
Sets lastModified only from a real content date, never from new Date()
Lists only locales where the page exists, and states that a sitemap does not guarantee indexing
Mentions submitting the sitemap in Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools

evals.source: user-report: issue 4, manual head content despite generateMetadata
evals.prompt: Why do I need to write head tags by hand when I already use generateMetadata? How should hreflang and JSON-LD be done?
assertions: Says canonical, alternates.languages, Open Graph, and robots belong in generateMetadata or createLocalizedMetadata
Says JSON-LD is a script in a Server Component, not part of the Metadata object
Says to escape < when serializing JSON-LD
Says JSON-LD must describe only content visible on the page
Says hreflang comes from one source and the proxy alternateLinks header stays off
